colors.intro: The tones of the Material 3 palettes, as used by the bg-<palette>-<tone> and text-<palette>-<tone> classes.

icons.failed: The icon list could not be loaded.

grid.intro: The grid has 12 columns. Classes without an infix apply at every width; an infix applies from its breakpoint up:
grid.formly: The dynamic forms use the same classes for their layout:

all.title: All breakpoints
all.description: Equal columns with .col, sized columns with .col-<n>, at every width.

stacked.title: Stacked to horizontal
stacked.description: Stacked on phones, side by side from the sm breakpoint.

mixed.title: Mix and match
mixed.description: Different spans per breakpoint on the same column.

offset.title: Offsets
offset.description: offset-<n> leaves n columns free before a column.

gutters.title: No gutters
gutters.description: no-gutters removes the space between the columns of a row.

helpers.intro: Every helper class of the stylesheet with what it applies. Most also exist per breakpoint with an infix (d-md-none, text-sm-center); spacing sides are logical: l and r follow the text direction.

switching.intro: Roles and permissions live in PermissionStore as signals. Switch the role: the side menu, the *appCan directive and every permission check update at once.
switching.hint: Try GUEST: the menu hides the pages a guest may not open.

guard.intro: This page is protected by permissionGuard: GUEST users are sent to the dashboard. Switch to GUEST and the guard checks the page again.

test.intro: The *appCan directive renders its template only for users who pass the rule, or its else template. Grant or revoke a permission and watch the examples change.
test.both: Visible to ADMIN and MANAGER, unless they have canPublish.
test.else: Hidden: the else template is shown instead.

menu_level.depth: This page is {{depth}} levels deep in the menu. The side menu opens every group on the way, and the breadcrumb shows the same path.

dynamic.intro: These forms are described as data and rendered by ngx-formly with its Angular Material field types, a custom combobox type (mtx-select) and the CSS grid classes.

placeholders.text: Type here to enable the next field
placeholders.text2: Disabled while the field above is empty

select.intro: mtx-select of @ng-matero/extensions: a searchable select with items from a loader or an array, inline options, tags and a panel that also opens inside dialogs.

source.title: Data sources
source.loader: Items loaded asynchronously (half a second), with a loading state
source.array: Items from an array of objects
source.simple: Items from an array of simple values

tags.title: Tags
tags.default: Add a new item by typing it
tags.custom: Add tags with a function and hide the selected items
tags.server: Create tags on the server (one second), with a loading state
tags.free: Tags without a dropdown panel (Enter or Tab adds)

dialog.title: Select in a dialog
dialog.intro: The select's panel opens above the dialog.

datetime.intro: mtx-datetimepicker of @ng-matero/extensions picks dates with times, times alone, months and years, here through its date-fns adapter in the locale of the language.
datetime.title: Pickers

fields.datetime12hTyped: Date and time, 12-hour clock, typed time
fields.filter: Date and time with a filter
fields.touch: Date and time for touch screens

hints.filter: Even years, months, days, hours and minutes only

errors.min: This is earlier than the first allowed time
errors.max: This is later than the last allowed time
errors.filter: This date or time is not allowed
